sentences.text: During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed affidavits.

The affidavits read as follows:
"AFFIDAVIT We, Sri. Rajan V., S/o. Vedamanickam, Aged about 45 years, and Vedamanickam Ilango, S/o. Ilango, Aged about 82 years, residing with my son Rajan V., both Residing at No. 105, Sai Deep Heaven Apartment, Sri Rama Temple Road,
New Thippasandra, Bengaluru 560 075; do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath:
1.
I am the Petitioner No.1 in the above petition and I know the facts and circumstances of the case.
I am swearing to this Affidavit for myself and my father (Petitioner No.2) is also swearing to this affidavit.
2. We state that, the Respondent No.2 and Petitioner No.1 got married to each other on 22.11.2015.
Out of the wedlock, Petitioner No.1 and Respondent No.2 have given birth to a boy child on 02.02.2018.
Currently the child is 6 years old.
3. We submit that there were certain difference of opinion which had cropped up between Respondent No.2 and Petitioner No.1 during the last quarter of 2022.

The Respondent No.2 had even filed a complaint against both of us with the Jeevan Bheemanagar Police which resulted in registration of the impugned FIR in Crime No.
271/2022 and subsequently numbered as CC No. 56051/2023 (upon filing of final report) and the same is pending before the X ACMM, Mayo Hall Unit, Bengaluru.
NC: 2024:KHC:45104 4.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Subsequently, Respondent No.2 and Petitioner No.1 have sorted out the differences and have decided to continue with the marital life to foster the growth of the son.
Thereafter, I have visited my wife in Rajasthan often and this has renewed our interest in this marriage.
5. We submit that we are ever-willing to take good care of Respondent No.2 and the child.

Moreso, I,
Rajan am willing to take care of my wife and son.
My wife has also agreed to resume our marital life.

I submit that this case in CC No. 56051/2023 pending before X Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Mayo Hall, Bengaluru City should not come in the way of leading a blissful marital life with the Respondent No.2 and having cordial relationship with my father (Petitioner No.2).

Vedamanickam, aged about 40 years, currently residing at No. A-32, Sky High Residency, Hanuman Ghar road, Sri Ganga Nagar, Rajasthan- 335 001, having come to Bengaluru today, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
1. I am the Respondent No.2 in the above petition and I know the facts and circumstances of the case.
I am swearing to this Affidavit for myself.
2. I state that, the Petitioner No.1 and myself got married to each other on 22.11.2015.
Out of the wedlock, I have given birth to a boy child on 02.02.2018.
Currently our son is 6 years old.
3. I submit that the Petitioner No.1 used to mentally harass and had physically assaulted me.
On 14.12.2022, I had approached the jurisdictional Police by filing a Complaint against the Petitioner No.1 as well as Petitioner NC: 2024:KHC:45104 No.2.
This Complaint culminated in registration of FIR in Crime No. 271/2022 before the Jeevan Bheemanagar Police Station.

The FIR so registered, was for the offences punishable under Section 324, 506, 498-A, 504 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4.
Subsequent to filing of this FIR, my husband and my father- in-law (Petitioner Nos. 1 & 2) had left the house.
In the month of January 2023, I shifted to Sri Ganga Nagar, Rajasthan along with my son because of a new job prospect.
Our son had fallen ill in February 2023.
On this pretext the Petitioner No.1 had visited us in Rajasthan for the first time after the registration of FIR.
5. I submit that the Petitioner No.1 and myself decided to keep aside the differences in order to facilitate our son's upbringing/growth.
During our son's exam in September 2023
, the Petitioner No.1 visited us and stayed with us for about a month.
Then again the Petitioner No.1 has visited us for about a month during January 2024 to support me during my interview and also to celebrate our son's birthday.
Additionally, the Petitioner No.1 flew our son to Bengaluru during his school summer vacation in June 2024.
6. I submit that the Petitioner No. 1 has again spent about a month with us in September 2024 during our son's examinations.
From the aforesaid conduct of the Petitioner No. 1, it appears that the Petitioner No.1 has transformed his approach towards me and our son.
In view of the same, I have decided to resume my matrimonial life with the Petitioner No.1.
The Petitioner No.1 has also promised to not repeat his previous actions of mentally harassing me or physically harassing me.

7. I submit that I do not wish that the Petitioner No. 1 or Petitioner No.2 be prosecuted further pursuant to my compliant dated 14.12.2022 and the resultant FIR in Crime No. 271/2022 (Final Report in CC No. 56051/2023) pending before X Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Mayo Hall,
Bengaluru City.

sentences.text: Therefore, in view of this affidavit, I have no objection to quash the proceedings initiated pursuant to FIR in Crime No. 271/2022 (CC No. 56051/2023) against the Petitioner No.1 as well as Petitioner No.2.

Wherefore, I most respectfully pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to accept this Affidavit and quash the criminal proceeding in Cr. No.271/2022 (C.C. No. 56051/2023) pending before X Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Mayo Hall, Bengaluru City in the interest of equity."
4.

In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to accept the affidavits and close the proceedings on the score that husband and wife have begun to live together now.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i. Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. Proceedings in C.C.No.56051/2023 pending before the X ACMM, Mayo Hall,
Bangalore, stands quashed, qua the petitioners.

Sd/-
